knowledge.textEn: NVIDIA telemetry distinguishes power and thermal clock limits; this lab compares short and sustained synthetic traces.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
knowledge.textEn: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 總工作=Σrate_i×time_i；平均速率=總工作/總時間，不能平均不同長度區段而不加權。
knowledge.textEn: Total work=Σrate×time; average rate is total work/time, not an unweighted mean of unequal intervals.

quiz.question: 「負載與遙測」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Load and telemetry: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 把產出、時脈、溫度和clock-event原因對齊同一時間戳；只有相關不等於因果。
時脈下降伴熱事件支持熱限制；無熱事件且輸入佇列空則偏向供料不足，需分開驗證。
以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 前20 s為100工作/s，後40 s為70工作/s，總60 s；速率是合成量。
optionsEn: Align work, clocks, temperature and event reasons on one timeline; correlation alone is not causation.
Clock drops with thermal events support thermal limiting; empty input queues without thermal events suggest starvation.
All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. First20 s at 100 work units/s, next40 s at 70, total 60 s; all rates synthetic.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。把產出、時脈、溫度和clock-event原因對齊同一時間戳；只有相關不等於因果。 與本階段判準一起判讀：使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Align work, clocks, temperature and event reasons on one timeline; correlation alone is not causation. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.

steps.title: 負載與遙測 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Load and telemetry · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「負載與遙測」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Load and telemetry and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
把產出、時脈、溫度和clock-event原因對齊同一時間戳；只有相關不等於因果。
回到本階段實驗：畫工作產生、加速器處理、冷卻與遙測讀取的邊界，量測不得改變安全限制。 NVIDIA遙測區分功率與熱等降頻原因；本課用合成時間序列比較短測與持續負載。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
steps.instructionEn:
Align work, clocks, temperature and event reasons on one timeline; correlation alone is not causation.
Return to the investigation: Map workload, accelerator, cooling and telemetry boundaries without changing protective limits. NVIDIA telemetry distinguishes power and thermal clock limits; this lab compares short and sustained synthetic traces.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。把產出、時脈、溫度和clock-event原因對齊同一時間戳；只有相關不等於因果。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Align work, clocks, temperature and event reasons on one timeline; correlation alone is not causation.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
steps.checkEn: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.

quiz.question: 「負載與遙測」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Load and telemetry: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付對齊遙測、加權吞吐、冷暖差異與原因判別證據。
時脈下降伴熱事件支持熱限制；無熱事件且輸入佇列空則偏向供料不足，需分開驗證。
optionsEn: Work4800, mean 80 units/s.
Deliver aligned telemetry, weighted throughput, cold/warm difference and diagnostic evidence.
Clock drops with thermal events support thermal limiting; empty input queues without thermal events suggest starvation.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。時脈下降伴熱事件支持熱限制；無熱事件且輸入佇列空則偏向供料不足，需分開驗證。 與本階段判準一起判讀：使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Clock drops with thermal events support thermal limiting; empty input queues without thermal events suggest starvation. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.

steps.title: 負載與遙測 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Load and telemetry · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「負載與遙測」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Load and telemetry and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
時脈下降伴熱事件支持熱限制；無熱事件且輸入佇列空則偏向供料不足，需分開驗證。
對照「負載與遙測」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。使用廠商正常限制下的監測與維護，不停用保護；以穩態窗口重做性能測試。
本階段必須重驗：使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
steps.instructionEn:
Clock drops with thermal events support thermal limiting; empty input queues without thermal events suggest starvation.
Against the nominal Load and telemetry result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Monitor and maintain within vendor limits without disabling protection; retest in steady state.
Reverify this criterion: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。時脈下降伴熱事件支持熱限制；無熱事件且輸入佇列空則偏向供料不足，需分開驗證。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Clock drops with thermal events support thermal limiting; empty input queues without thermal events suggest starvation.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
steps.checkEn: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.

quiz.question: 「負載與遙測」：哪一項提供依證據採取處置或重新驗證的條件？
quiz.questionEn: Load and telemetry: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 總工作=Σrate_i×time_i；平均速率=總工作/總時間，不能平均不同長度區段而不加權。
使用廠商正常限制下的監測與維護，不停用保護；以穩態窗口重做性能測試。
NVIDIA遙測區分功率與熱等降頻原因；本課用合成時間序列比較短測與持續負載。
optionsEn: Total work=Σrate×time; average rate is total work/time, not an unweighted mean of unequal intervals.
Monitor and maintain within vendor limits without disabling protection; retest in steady state.
NVIDIA telemetry distinguishes power and thermal clock limits; this lab compares short and sustained synthetic traces.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。使用廠商正常限制下的監測與維護，不停用保護；以穩態窗口重做性能測試。 與本階段判準一起判讀：使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Monitor and maintain within vendor limits without disabling protection; retest in steady state. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.

steps.title: 負載與遙測 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Load and telemetry · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「負載與遙測」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Load and telemetry and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付對齊遙測、加權吞吐、冷暖差異與原因判別證據。
在交接件中加入「負載與遙測」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver aligned telemetry, weighted throughput, cold/warm difference and diagnostic evidence.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Load and telemetry: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
steps.checkEn: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.
